name: Skeleton Finger
summary: In Duskwood, restless dead yield Skeleton Finger to Madame Eva of Darkshire. She gathers them with ghoul fangs and spider venom to make protective talismans.

sections.title: Bones of the Restless
sections.body: Skeletal raiders and warriors rise across Duskwood, along with necrotic mages and fiends. Most travelers leave their foul remains alone, but fortune tellers and mystics prize their cold essence. Madame Eva, the seer of Darkshire, gathers their bony fingers for the Totem of Infliction. She binds their lingering necrotic energies into a ward that strikes back at attackers.

faq.q: What creatures drop a Skeleton Finger?
faq.answer: Skeleton Fingers come from Skeletal Raiders, Healers, Warders, Warriors, Horrors, Fiends, and Skeletal Mages across Duskwood.

faq.q: Who wants Skeleton Fingers in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Madame Eva, the seer of Darkshire, needs Skeleton Fingers to make a protective ward.

faq.q: What is the Totem of Infliction?
faq.answer: Madame Eva makes the Totem of Infliction from skeleton fingers, ghoul fangs, and spider venom. She binds their dark energies into an aura that harms anyone who attacks its bearer.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need undead remains for a protective charm?
faq.answer: Madame Eva uses the lingering taint and aggression of local creatures in her rituals. She binds the violent essences of Duskwood's skeletons, ghouls, and venomous beasts into a ward that punishes attackers.

angles.text: As a mage studying folk divination, you may find Madame Eva's use of skeletal digits and natural venoms in a retaliatory enchantment an unusual blend of hedge witchcraft and sympathetic magic.
As a paladin, you may shudder at desecrating skeletal remains and carrying their severed parts. In Duskwood's dire gloom, using the bones of the unholy to shield the living is a grim necessity.
